# OpenFreeMap Vector Tile Service

- **Source**: OpenFreeMap / OpenStreetMap Contributors
- **URL**: https://tiles.openfreemap.org/planet
- **Licence**: Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0 / CC BY-SA 2.0
- **Use**: Vector tile queries for roads, paths, buildings, waterways, landuse polygons
- **Access Route**: Mapbox Vector Tile (MVT) protocol via HTTPS
